description: End moment of a lamp and whether it is still lit at a given moment. All moments are absolute instants (UTC); the server clock decides.

inputs.lit_at: instant the lamp was lit, RFC 3339 UTC
inputs.now: the instant being checked, RFC 3339 UTC

output.end_at: lit_at + duration_days x 24 hours, RFC 3339 UTC
output.is_lit: true while now is earlier than end_at

cases.name: 1-day lamp ends exactly 24 hours after lighting
cases.source: arithmetic from BR-LMP-03 (days x 24 hours) and BR-LMP-04
